iterations.theme: Antunovski hod: Duhovna obnova, zajedništvo i autentična vjera mladih

sections.subtitle: Povratak uz snažnog gosta: Najava osmog Antunovskog hoda
sections.screenshot_description: Marko s osmijehom najavljuje fra Stjepana Brčinu i Antunovski hod.
sections.content: Marko, voditelj podcasta udruge Mladi za domovinu, pozdravlja slušatelje i najavljuje povratnički podcast s posebnim gostom, fra Stjepanom Brčinom. Glavni povod razgovora je osmi Antunovski hod, koji se ove godine održava 6. lipnja. Marko ističe fra Stjepana kao 'jako ime' i 'jakog gosta', a ujedno i svog dobrog prijatelja, naglašavajući važnost nadolazećeg događaja za mlade.
sections.subtitle_en: Return with a strong guest: Announcement of the eighth Antunovski hod
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko announces fra Stjepan Brčina and Antunovski hod with a smile.
sections.content_en: Marko, the host of the podcast of the association Mladi za domovinu, greets the listeners and announces a comeback podcast with a special guest, fra Stjepan Brčina. The main occasion for the conversation is the eighth Antunovski hod, which is being held on June 6 this year. Marko highlights fra Stjepan as a 'strong name' and a 'strong guest', and at the same time his good friend, emphasizing the importance of the upcoming event for young people.

sections.subtitle: Iza kulisa: Mukotrpan rad i duhovna borba za Antunovski hod
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan ozbiljno govori o duhovnoj pripremi za hod.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan Brčina opisuje intenzivne pripreme za Antunovski hod, ističući da je organizacija iznimno zahtjevna jer se događaj odvija na više lokacija, što zahtijeva povezivanje programa, ljudi i logistike u jedan 'mozaik'. Unatoč umoru, fra Stjepan izražava radost zbog finalizacije priprema. Poseban naglasak stavlja na **duhovnu pripremu**, molitvu za sve sudionike i zaštitu od zloga. Objašnjava da sve što je dobro i duhovno privlači kušnje i napasti, ali da su organizatori toga svjesni i da se intenzivno mole kako bi hod bio istinska duhovna obnova, a ne samo 'prazno šetanje'.
sections.subtitle_en: Behind the scenes: Painstaking work and spiritual battle for Antunovski hod
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan speaks seriously about the spiritual preparation for the walk.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan Brčina describes the intense preparations for the Antunovski hod, pointing out that the organization is extremely demanding because the event takes place at multiple locations, which requires connecting the program, people, and logistics into one 'mosaic'. Despite fatigue, fra Stjepan expresses joy over the finalization of the preparations. He places special emphasis on **spiritual preparation**, prayer for all participants, and protection from the evil one. He explains that everything that is good and spiritual attracts trials and temptations, but that the organizers are aware of this and are praying intensively so that the walk would be a true spiritual renewal, and not just 'empty walking'.

sections.subtitle: Od online propovijedi do stvarnog susreta: Nezamjenjiva uloga laika
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan gestikulira dok govori o podršci laika.
sections.content: Marko primjećuje da javnost često vidi samo 'kremu' Antunovskog hoda, dok iza toga stoji mukotrpan rad. Fra Stjepan potvrđuje da pripreme počinju odmah nakon završetka prethodnog hoda, uključujući papirologiju, promociju i obilazak župa diljem Hrvatske i inozemstva. Posebno zahvaljuje **laicima i mladima** koji su se organizirali, potaknuli svoje župljane i prijatelje te podmetnuli leđa za organizaciju autobusa i prijevoza. Fra Stjepan naglašava važnost **fizičkog kontakta** u evangelizaciji, ističući da, iako koriste medije, osobni susret s ljudima omogućuje bolje razumijevanje i očekivanja. Kritizira 'online propovjednike' čije su crkve prazne, naglašavajući da je autentična vjera uvijek povezana sa stvarnim zajedništvom.
sections.subtitle_en: From an online sermon to a real encounter: The irreplaceable role of the laity
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan gesticulates while speaking about the support of the laity.
sections.content_en: Marko notices that the public often sees only the 'cream' of the Antunovski hod, while painstaking work stands behind it. Fra Stjepan confirms that preparations begin immediately after the end of the previous walk, including paperwork, promotion, and visiting parishes throughout Croatia and abroad. He especially thanks the **laity and young people** who organized themselves, encouraged their parishioners and friends, and shouldered the burden of organizing buses and transportation. Fra Stjepan emphasizes the importance of **physical contact** in evangelization, pointing out that, although they use media, personal encounter with people allows for better understanding and expectations. He criticizes 'online preachers' whose churches are empty, emphasizing that authentic faith is always connected with real communion.

sections.subtitle: Od vizije do masovnosti: Kontinuirana inovacija ključ je rasta Antunovskog hoda
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan s entuzijazmom govori o rastu hoda i viziji.
sections.content: Marko pita fra Stjepana o njegovim osjećajima gledajući rast Antunovskog hoda od šačice ljudi do preko 20.000 sudionika. Fra Stjepan otkriva da je prije osam godina imao viziju ispunjenog trga mladima, što je u suprotnosti s općim mišljenjem da mlade ne zanima vjera. Ističe da se nikada ne smije zadovoljiti postignutim, već da je potrebno biti **kreativan i inovativan** poput Duha Svetoga. Svake godine pristupa organizaciji kao da je prvi put, prepoznajući da je svaki hod jedinstven i sve zahtjevniji, što smatra pozitivnim znakom, jer 'najgore je kad se uljuljaš'.
sections.subtitle_en: From vision to mass scale: Continuous innovation is the key to the growth of Antunovski hod
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan speaks with enthusiasm about the growth of the walk and the vision.
sections.content_en: Marko asks fra Stjepan about his feelings watching the growth of the Antunovski hod from a handful of people to over 20,000 participants. Fra Stjepan reveals that eight years ago he had a vision of a square filled with young people, which is in contrast to the general opinion that young people are not interested in faith. He emphasizes that one must never be satisfied with what has been achieved, but that it is necessary to be **creative and innovative** like the Holy Spirit. Every year he approaches the organization as if it were the first time, recognizing that each walk is unique and increasingly demanding, which he considers a positive sign, because 'the worst is when you get lulled into complacency'.

sections.subtitle: Božja providnost u akciji: Neočekivana pomoć i zajedništvo
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan se smiješi dok priča anegdotu o kontejnerima.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan naglašava važnost evangelizacijske zajednice i podrške župe Svetog Antuna Padovanskog, koji su suorganizatori. Otkriva da je u organizaciju uključeno preko 300 ljudi iz različitih profesija. Dijeli anegdotu o tome kako je tražio kontejnere za smeće za polaznu točku u Dubravi, a nepoznati čovjek mu se javio putem Instagrama, nudeći pomoć sa svojim kamionima i vučnom službom. Taj čovjek je, bez ikakvog poticaja osim srca, osigurao kontejnere za više lokacija, što fra Stjepan tumači kao **Božju providnost**. Spominje i ekipu iz Splita koja svake godine donosi piće u hladnjačama, a vlasnik osobno sudjeluje u podjeli, želeći biti dio događaja. Ova podrška, uključujući medijske donacije i savjete oko papirologije, potvrđuje da ljudi prepoznaju Antunovski hod kao 'dobar i zdrav projekt za mlade'.
sections.subtitle_en: God's providence in action: Unexpected help and fellowship
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan smiles while telling an anecdote about containers.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan emphasizes the importance of the evangelization community and the support of the parish of Saint Anthony of Padua, who are the co-organizers. He reveals that over 300 people from various professions are involved in the organization. He shares an anecdote about how he was looking for garbage containers for the starting point in Dubrava, and an unknown man contacted him via Instagram, offering help with his trucks and towing service. That man, without any incentive other than his heart, provided containers for multiple locations, which fra Stjepan interprets as **God's providence**. He also mentions a team from Split that brings drinks in refrigerated trucks every year, and the owner personally participates in the distribution, wanting to be part of the event. This support, including media donations and advice on paperwork, confirms that people recognize Antunovski hod as a 'good and healthy project for young people'.

sections.subtitle: Više od hoda: Javno svjedočenje vjere i intenzivna duhovna obnova
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava važnost javnog svjedočenja vjere.
sections.content: Na pitanje što Antunovski hod nudi mladima, fra Stjepan ističe njegov **evangelizacijski karakter** i priliku za **javno svjedočenje vjere**, što je rijetkost. Uspoređuje to s apostolima koji su izlazili na trgove, naglašavajući da javno svjedočenje donosi posebnu milost. Hod je, objašnjava, **intenzivna duhovna obnova** čiji je koncept osmišljen tako da se srce sudionika postupno otvara kroz program koji uključuje pjesmu, nagovore, video, ispovijed, misu i sam hod. Osim duhovne dimenzije, hod nudi i priliku za upoznavanje i stvaranje prijateljstava, pa čak i brakova. Fizički napor hodanja, dodaje, ima duhovnu dimenziju jer 'kada smo fizički umorni, otvoreni smo duhovno', što ubrzava duhovnu obnovu.
sections.subtitle_en: More than a walk: Public witnessing of faith and intense spiritual renewal
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains the importance of public witness of faith.
sections.content_en: To the question of what Antunovski hod offers to young people, fra Stjepan highlights its **evangelizing character** and the opportunity for **public witnessing of faith**, which is a rarity. He compares this to the apostles who went out into the squares, emphasizing that public witnessing brings a special grace. The walk is, he explains, **an intensive spiritual renewal** whose concept is designed so that the heart of the participants opens gradually through a program that includes song, talks, video, confession, Mass, and the walk itself. Besides the spiritual dimension, the walk also offers an opportunity to meet people and form friendships, and even marriages. The physical exertion of walking, he adds, has a spiritual dimension because 'when we are physically tired, we are open spiritually', which accelerates spiritual renewal.

sections.subtitle: Duhovna lijenost i đavolje zamke: Zašto ne smijemo odustati od truda
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan gestikulira dok govori o preprekama.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan upozorava na **duhovnu lijenost** koja sprječava ljude da se trude za duhovne blagoslove. Dijeli anegdotu o mladiću koji je neprestano tražio molitve, ali nije bio spreman doći i moliti se osobno. Ističe da će đavao uvijek pronaći izgovore – poput lošeg vremena ili osjećaja usamljenosti – kako bi odvratio ljude od sudjelovanja u duhovnim događajima. Poručuje da se ne treba bojati doći sam, jer će se na hodu sigurno upoznati novi ljudi, a u najgorem slučaju, 'upoznat ćeš svećenika na ispovijedi'.
sections.subtitle_en: Spiritual laziness and the devil's traps: Why we must not give up on effort
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan gestures while speaking about obstacles.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan warns of **spiritual laziness** that prevents people from making an effort for spiritual blessings. He shares an anecdote about a young man who constantly asked for prayers, but was not ready to come and pray in person. He emphasizes that the devil will always find excuses – such as bad weather or a feeling of loneliness – in order to deter people from participating in spiritual events. He conveys that one should not be afraid to come alone, because on the walk one will surely meet new people, and in the worst case, 'you will meet a priest in confession'.

sections.subtitle: Živa vjera ne šuti: Hrabrost svjedočenja i snaga sakramenata
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan naglašava važnost govorenja o Bogu.
sections.content: Marko pita o strahu mladih od svjedočenja vjere. Fra Stjepan odgovara da je bojazan znak upitnog odnosa s Bogom, jer **živa vjera ne može šutjeti**. Podsjeća na apostole koji su hrabro svjedočili unatoč opasnosti po život. Ističe da Antunovski hod nudi bogatstvo **sakramenata** – ispovijed, misu, euharistijsko klanjanje – koji su ključni za duhovni život. Naglašava da bez milosti sakramenata nema duhovnosti i da su oni neophodni za borbu protiv zla.
sections.subtitle_en: Living faith is not silent: The courage of witnessing and the power of the sacraments
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan emphasizes the importance of speaking about God.
sections.content_en: Marko asks about young people's fear of witnessing to the faith. Fra Stjepan responds that fear is a sign of a questionable relationship with God, because **a living faith cannot be silent**. He recalls the apostles who courageously witnessed despite the danger to their lives. He points out that Antunovski hod offers a wealth of **sacraments** – confession, Mass, Eucharistic adoration – which are crucial for the spiritual life. He emphasizes that without the grace of the sacraments there is no spirituality and that they are essential for the fight against evil.

sections.subtitle: Euharistija i klanjanje: Od zaborava do srca duhovnosti mladih
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava kako su mladi prihvatili euharistijsko klanjanje.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan ističe da je u posljednje dvije godine intenzivno govorio o važnosti sakramenata, posebno **Euharistije i euharistijskog klanjanja**. Prisjeća se kako je prije desetak godina klanjanje bilo 'zaboravljena pobožnost' rezervirana za starije, dok je danas postalo centar duhovnih okupljanja mladih. S ponosom primjećuje da gotovo nijedna duhovna obnova nema plakat bez spomenutog klanjanja, a mladi su ti koji najviše sudjeluju. Objašnjava da je misa početak, a klanjanje njezin produžetak, te da je to promjena koja pokazuje kako su svećenici uspjeli približiti ove sakramente mladima.
sections.subtitle_en: The Eucharist and Eucharistic Adoration: From Oblivion to the Heart of Youth Spirituality
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains how the youth accepted Eucharistic adoration.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan emphasizes that over the last two years he has spoken intensively about the importance of the sacraments, especially the **Eucharist and Eucharistic adoration**. He recalls how about ten years ago adoration was a 'forgotten devotion' reserved for the elderly, while today it has become the center of spiritual gatherings of the youth. He notes with pride that almost no spiritual renewal has a poster without adoration mentioned, and the youth are the ones who participate the most. He explains that Mass is the beginning, and adoration its extension, and that this is a change that shows how priests have succeeded in bringing these sacraments closer to young people.

sections.subtitle: Protiv 'privatne vjere': Snaga sakramenata i euharistijska misterija
sections.content: Fra Stjepan naglašava da je Euharistija ključna za vječni život, podsjećajući na Isusovu zapovijed. Upozorava na opasnost **'privatne vjere'**, gdje ljudi misle da mogu biti vjernici bez crkve i sakramenata. Objašnjava da snaga sakramenata ne ovisi o svetosti svećenika, već o Božjoj milosti, uspoređujući to s manom u pustinji i 'rosom Duha Svetoga' koja posvećuje darove. Zanimljivo, fra Stjepan ističe da čak i sotonisti prepoznaju snagu posvećene hostije, što bi kršćanima trebalo biti podsjetnik na njezinu važnost i svetost. Bez sakramenata, kaže, ne možemo se oduprijeti zlu niti biti zaštićeni.
sections.subtitle_en: Against 'private faith': The power of the sacraments and the Eucharistic mystery
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains the theology of the Eucharist.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan emphasizes that the Eucharist is crucial for eternal life, reminding of Jesus' command. He warns of the danger of **'private faith'**, where people think they can be believers without the church and sacraments. He explains that the power of the sacraments does not depend on the holiness of the priest, but on God's grace, comparing this with the manna in the desert and the 'dew of the Holy Spirit' that sanctifies the gifts. Interestingly, fra Stjepan points out that even Satanists recognize the power of the consecrated host, which should be a reminder to Christians of its importance and holiness. Without the sacraments, he says, we cannot resist evil nor be protected.

sections.subtitle: Duhovno 'sunčanje' i jutarnja zaštita: Molitva kao štit za dan
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava kako se duhovno zaštititi.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan uspoređuje euharistijsko klanjanje sa **sunčanjem**: čak i ako ne osjetimo trenutnu promjenu, milost se polako spušta i jača nas za buduće izazove. Naglašava važnost **jutarnje duhovne pripreme**, uspoređujući je s fizičkom higijenom. Upozorava da bez molitve i zaštite Duha Svetoga, izlazimo u svijet nezaštićeni od duhovnih utjecaja poput straha, nemira ili psovke. Savjetuje da se ujutro molimo za strpljivost, ljubav i mudrost, jer to ne mijenja probleme, već našu percepciju i snagu da se s njima nosimo. Kao primjer navodi Majku Tereziju, koja je dan započinjala satom klanjanja kako bi imala snage za služenje.
sections.subtitle_en: Spiritual 'sunbathing' and morning protection: Prayer as a shield for the day
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains how to protect oneself spiritually.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan compares Eucharistic adoration to **sunbathing**: even if we do not feel an immediate change, grace slowly descends and strengthens us for future challenges. He emphasizes the importance of **morning spiritual preparation**, comparing it to physical hygiene. He warns that without prayer and the protection of the Holy Spirit, we go out into the world unprotected from spiritual influences such as fear, restlessness, or cursing. He advises that in the morning we pray for patience, love, and wisdom, because that does not change the problems, but rather our perception and strength to deal with them. As an example, he cites Mother Teresa, who began the day with an hour of adoration in order to have the strength for service.

sections.subtitle: Molitva srcem: Iskrenost, vapaj i Duh Sveti kao vodič
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava kako moliti iskreno.
sections.content: Marko pita kako moliti 'srcem'. Fra Stjepan objašnjava da je **Duh Sveti protagonist svake prave molitve**, čineći je lakom i iskrenom. Kritizira mehaničko moljenje napamet bez uključenosti srca i uma. Savjetuje da se molitva započne zahvalnošću, a zatim da se iskreno iznesu sve brige i problemi, 'isprazni čaša' srca kako bi je Bog mogao ispuniti. Naglašava da je **iskrenost ključna**, a najjače molitve su često **vapaji** iz srca, posebno kada se dođe do 'zida'. Takav vapaj, iako možda bolan, oslobađa i otvara srce Bogu.
sections.subtitle_en: Prayer with the heart: Sincerity, cry, and the Holy Spirit as a guide
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains how to pray sincerely.
sections.content_en: Marko asks how to pray 'with the heart'. Fra Stjepan explains that the **Holy Spirit is the protagonist of every true prayer**, making it easy and sincere. He criticizes mechanical praying by heart without the involvement of the heart and mind. He advises that prayer begin with thanksgiving, and then that all worries and problems be sincerely presented, to 'empty the cup' of the heart so that God can fill it. He emphasizes that **sincerity is key**, and the strongest prayers are often **cries** from the heart, especially when one reaches a 'wall'. Such a cry, although perhaps painful, liberates and opens the heart to God.

sections.subtitle: Božja riječ: Ogledalo za čišćenje slike o Bogu
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan drži ruku na srcu dok govori o Božjoj riječi.
sections.content: Na pitanje pomaže li iskrena molitva u čišćenju slike o Bogu, fra Stjepan odgovara potvrdno, ali naglašava da **Božja riječ** najviše korigira naše predodžbe o Bogu. Savjetuje da se Sveto pismo čita pažljivo, uz molitvu Duhu Svetom, više puta, osluškujući koja riječ ili rečenica 'zaigra srce'. Kada se osjeti takav dodir, treba se pitati što Bog želi poručiti, meditirati o tome i pretvoriti to u molitvu zahvale. Tu riječ potom treba živjeti cijeli dan, dopuštajući joj da nas korigira i ohrabruje, čineći je živom i djelotvornom u svakodnevici.
sections.subtitle_en: God's Word: A Mirror for Purifying the Image of God
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan holds his hand on his heart while speaking about the Word of God.
sections.content_en: To the question of whether sincere prayer helps in purifying the image of God, fra Stjepan answers affirmatively, but emphasizes that **the Word of God** most corrects our perceptions of God. He advises that Sacred Scripture be read carefully, with prayer to the Holy Spirit, multiple times, listening to which word or sentence 'makes the heart leap'. When such a touch is felt, one should ask oneself what God wants to communicate, meditate on it, and turn it into a prayer of thanksgiving. That word should then be lived throughout the entire day, allowing it to correct and encourage us, making it living and effective in everyday life.

sections.subtitle: Prijateljstvo kao balzam života: Snaga zajednice i duhovna selekcija
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava važnost duhovnih prijateljstava.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan ističe da smo 'dar jedni drugima' i naglašava važnost **zajednice i duhovnih prijateljstava**. Citira Knjigu Mudrosti, govoreći da je 'pravi prijatelj balzam života'. Smatra da je blagoslov imati oko sebe zdrave ljude i društvo s kojima se može razgovarati o vjeri. Kao primjer navodi susret Marije i Elizabete, koje su se mogle razumjeti u svojim čudesnim iskustvima. Vjeruje da će Bog, ako smo mu bliski, prirodno pročistiti naše okruženje i dovesti prave prijatelje. Potiče mlade na aktivno uključivanje u župni pastoral i korištenje svojih talenata, jer 'svi bi htjeli promjenu crkve, župe, biskupije, a ne bi se uključili nigdje'.
sections.subtitle_en: Friendship as the balm of life: The strength of community and spiritual selection
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains the importance of spiritual friendships.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan points out that we are 'a gift to one another' and emphasizes the importance of **community and spiritual friendships**. He cites the Book of Wisdom, saying that 'a true friend is the balm of life'. He considers it a blessing to have healthy people around oneself and company with whom one can talk about faith. As an example, he cites the encounter of Mary and Elizabeth, who were able to understand each other in their miraculous experiences. He believes that God, if we are close to Him, will naturally purify our surroundings and bring true friends. He encourages young people to actively get involved in parish pastoral ministry and use their talents, because 'everyone would like a change of the church, parish, diocese, and would not get involved anywhere'.

sections.subtitle: Originali, ne kopije: Pronalaženje autentičnosti u Božjem identitetu
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava da naša vrijednost dolazi od Boga.
sections.content: Marko spominje izreku Carla Acutisa da se rađamo kao originali, a umiremo kao kopije. Fra Stjepan se slaže, objašnjavajući da naša **autentičnost i originalnost dolaze od Boga**. Upozorava da mnogi svoju vrijednost traže u tuđim mišljenjima ili materijalnim stvarima, što vodi razočaranju. Ističe da naša **vrijednost proizlazi iz toga što smo Božji**, bez obzira na to vole li nas drugi ili što misle o nama. Naglašava da naša vrijednost nije u onome što imamo (automobil, diploma), već u našem identitetu ljubljene djece Božje.
sections.subtitle_en: Originals, not copies: Finding authenticity in God's identity
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains that our value comes from God.
sections.content_en: Marko mentions the saying of Carlo Acutis that we are born as originals, and die as copies. Fra Stjepan agrees, explaining that our **authenticity and originality come from God**. He warns that many seek their worth in other people's opinions or material things, which leads to disappointment. He points out that our **worth stems from the fact that we are God's**, regardless of whether others love us or what they think about us. He emphasizes that our worth is not in what we have (car, diploma), but in our identity as beloved children of God.

sections.subtitle: Kušnje kao znak autentične vjere: Ne bojte se đavla, Bog je iznad svega
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava da su kušnje znak duhovnog života.
sections.content: Na pitanje kako živjeti autentično unatoč brojnim napastima, fra Stjepan odgovara da su **kušnje i napasti najbolja provjera autentičnosti** našeg odnosa s Bogom. Podsjeća da je Isus rekao da će i njegove sljedbenike progoniti. Smatra da oni koji nemaju kušnje i probleme trebaju se zapitati zašto ih nemaju, jer to može biti znak duhovne mrtvosti. Đavao napada one koji žele napraviti iskorak prema Bogu. Ipak, fra Stjepan upozorava da se ne treba pretjerano fokusirati na đavla, jer je **Bog iznad svega** i vodi one koji su mu predani. Naglašava da nas Bog nije stavio u svijet da se mučimo, već nam daje milost i snagu, jer je 'sve u njegovim rukama'.
sections.subtitle_en: Temptations as a sign of authentic faith: Do not be afraid of the devil, God is above all
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains that temptations are a sign of spiritual life.
sections.content_en: To the question of how to live authentically despite numerous temptations, fra Stjepan responds that **trials and temptations are the best test of the authenticity** of our relationship with God. He recalls that Jesus said that his followers would also be persecuted. He considers that those who do not have trials and problems should ask themselves why they do not have them, because that can be a sign of spiritual deadness. The devil attacks those who want to take a step forward toward God. Nevertheless, fra Stjepan warns that one should not excessively focus on the devil, because **God is above all** and leads those who are surrendered to him. He emphasizes that God did not put us in the world to suffer, but gives us grace and strength, because 'everything is in his hands'.

sections.subtitle: Glad za duhovnošću: Mladi se bude, Crkva mora ponuditi sadržaj
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan s osmijehom govori o entuzijazmu mladih.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan primjećuje **duhovno buđenje među mladima**, koji su 'gladni i zainteresirani' za duhovni sadržaj. Navodi primjere mladih koji putuju stotine kilometara, čak i iz inozemstva, kako bi sudjelovali u duhovnim programima. Posebno ga je oduševila situacija u Kninu, gdje je cijela muška ekipa došla na duhovnu obnovu. Zaključuje da Crkva ne smije kritizirati mlade, već im mora **ponuditi sadržaj** i biti kreativna. Ističe da su svi njegovi dosadašnji projekti za mlade bili iznimno posjećeni, što pokazuje da 'samo fali mjesto' i da mladi rado dolaze kada im se nešto ponudi.
sections.subtitle_en: Hunger for spirituality: The youth are waking up, the Church must offer content
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan speaks with a smile about the enthusiasm of the youth.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan notices a **spiritual awakening among the youth**, who are 'hungry and interested' in spiritual content. He cites examples of young people traveling hundreds of kilometers, even from abroad, in order to participate in spiritual programs. He was especially thrilled by the situation in Knin, where an entire group of men came to a spiritual renewal. He concludes that the Church must not criticize young people, but must **offer content** to them and be creative. He points out that all of his projects for youth so far have been exceptionally well-attended, which shows that 'only a place is missing' and that young people gladly come when something is offered to them.

sections.subtitle: Franjevački kamp: Novi prostor i sadržaji za mlade
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan objašnjava viziju Franjevačkog kampa.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan najavljuje projekt izgradnje **Franjevačkog kampa**, motiviran potrebom za više prostora i dodatnim sadržajima za mlade. Objašnjava da je osam godina rada na Svetom Duhu pokazalo da postoji potreba za proširenjem postojećeg pastorala. Kamp je zamišljen kao nadogradnja i proširenje, a ne zamjena za postojeće aktivnosti. Iako ne otkriva sve detalje, ističe da će kamp ponuditi nove evangelizacijske inicijative i sadržaje, potvrđujući svoju filozofiju stalne inovacije u radu s mladima.
sections.subtitle_en: Franciscan Camp: New space and activities for youth
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan explains the vision of the Franciscan Camp.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan announces the project of building the **Franciscan Camp**, motivated by the need for more space and additional content for young people. He explains that eight years of work at Sveti Duh have shown that there is a need to expand the existing pastoral ministry. The camp is conceived as an upgrade and expansion, and not a replacement for existing activities. Although he does not reveal all the details, he emphasizes that the camp will offer new evangelization initiatives and content, confirming his philosophy of constant innovation in working with young people.

sections.subtitle: Posljednji poziv: Antunovski hod, aplikacija i blagoslov biskupa
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Stjepan pokazuje na zamišljenu aplikaciju.
sections.content: Fra Stjepan upućuje poziv svima, mladima i onima koji se tako osjećaju, da dođu na Antunovski hod, naglašavajući da je ruta prilagođena svima. Posebno najavljuje novu aplikaciju **'Antunovski hod Mladi'**, koja nudi sve informacije o hodu, praćenje rute, molitve svetom Antunu te sudjelovanje u nagradnoj igri s vrijednim nagradama (hodočašće u Padovu, ljetovanje na Franjevačkom kampu na Cresu, paket opreme za hod). Marko ponavlja tehničke detalje: predprogram počinje u 12 sati, sveta misa u 14 sati, nakon čega slijedi hod, molitva s evangelizacijskom zajednicom i euharistijsko klanjanje. Fra Stjepan dodaje da će na kraju hoda sudionike dočekati i biskup s blagoslovom.
sections.subtitle_en: Last call: Antunovski hod, the app, and the bishop's blessing
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Stjepan points to an imaginary application.
sections.content_en: Fra Stjepan extends an invitation to everyone, young people and those who feel that way, to come to the Antunovski hod, emphasizing that the route is adapted to everyone. He especially announces the new application **'Antunovski hod Mladi'**, which offers all information about the walk, route tracking, prayers to Saint Anthony, and participation in a giveaway with valuable prizes (a pilgrimage to Padova, a summer stay at the Franciscan camp on Cres, an equipment package for the walk). Marko repeats the technical details: the pre-program begins at 12:00, Holy Mass at 14:00, followed by the walk, prayer with the evangelization community, and Eucharistic adoration. Fra Stjepan adds that at the end of the walk, a bishop will also welcome the participants with a blessing.
